title: Cheesy Spinach Stuffed Chicken Breasts
description: Chicken breasts with a pocket of cream cheese, spinach, mozzarella and Parmesan, seared golden in cast iron and finished in the oven.

steps.heading: Make the Filling
steps.text: In a medium bowl, mix the cream cheese, mayonnaise, salt and garlic well. Add the spinach, mozzarella and Parmesan and mix well.

steps.heading: Stuff
steps.text: Cut a slit in the side of each chicken breast to make a deep pocket. Fill each with a third of the mixture and seal the slits with toothpicks — count how many you use.

steps.heading: Season
steps.text: Season the outside with salt, pepper, garlic powder and paprika.

steps.heading: Sear
steps.text: Heat the oil in a cast-iron pan over medium heat. Once hot, sear the chicken about 4 minutes per side, until golden brown — turn the heat up if it's not browning, down if it's browning too fast.

steps.heading: Finish in the Oven
steps.text: Move the pan to the oven for 10 to 15 minutes, depending on thickness, until the chicken reaches 165°F. Let it rest 5 minutes, then remove all the toothpicks.
